_note: Catalog of product images. One entry per image file in src/assets/screens/. origin is 'capture' (a real capture of the app) or 'design-render' (rendered from the app design mockup, for views the app does not match yet). crop is [x, y, width, height] in CSS pixels of the 1920 by 1240 window. mobile is an optional second crop (about 4:3) used on narrow screens. `use` points a slot at another entry's image. alt is required for every image: scripts/make-screens.mjs and ShotFrame fail without it. Rebuild the files with `node scripts/make-screens.mjs --captures DIR --renders DIR`.

hero-layout.alt: The PCBCraft Layout tab: the Layers tree on the left, a 60 by 40 millimetre board with three footprints and dashed connection lines in the middle, Properties for the selected LED on the right, and the Findings sheet below.

home-schematic.alt: A schematic sheet with a connector J1, a 330 ohm resistor R1 and a green LED D1 joined by wires, with VCC and GND power symbols, row and column markers and a title block.

home-layout.alt: The board canvas: a 60 by 40 millimetre outline with chamfered corners, two mounting holes and three footprints joined by dashed connection lines, with rulers and a 60 millimetre dimension.

layout-routed.alt: A routed sensor board in the layout view: red top copper and blue bottom copper traces joining a microcontroller, a USB connector, resistors, capacitors and LEDs inside a rounded board outline.

home-libraries.alt: The Library tab beside the board: a keyword box, Symbols, Footprints and Both buttons, and cards for Resistor, LED, Capacitor and a two-pin connector, each with its source, pad count and pin count.

home-outputs.alt: The Manufacture tab: an Outputs tree with Gerber files, drill, bill of materials and machine jobs marked Current or Stale, beside a toolpath preview of the board outline and pads.

view3d.alt: The board in the 3D view from an isometric angle, with a green board, a black two-pin connector, a small resistor and a round green LED.

layers-tree.alt: The Layers tree: a filter box, Show all, Hide others and New layer, then Layer 1 Top with Copper, Solder mask, Silkscreen, Paste and Components, Layer 2 Bottom, Board edge, Parts and Nets, each with a lock and an eye toggle.

bottom-sheet.alt: The bottom sheet under the canvas: Findings, Output and Console tabs, a Run checks button, and a list of findings that each have Show, Hide and Mute buttons.
